unresolved: Mathlib defines arctan z = -i/2 · log((1 + z i)/(1 - z i)); CMP 1 is (i/2) ln((1 - i z)/(1 + i z)). Equality off the branch cuts is not proved here.
Values on the branch cuts (z = i y, |y| > 1) depend on the logarithm's cut convention; agreement with OpenMath there is unverified.
Complex.arctan_tan requires -(π/2) < re z ≤ π/2 and z ≠ π/2, not the open real interval of CMP 2.
interpretations.justification: Principal inverse tangent; agrees with the CMP 1 logarithmic formula off the branch cuts.
interpretations.definedness: z ≠ i and z ≠ -i (Lean assigns values at ±i)

findings: operational: the v0.1 profiles do not terminate. angle_sum.sin_add and product_to_sum.sin_cos reproduce sin(x + y), angle_sum.cos_sub and product_to_sum.sin_sin reproduce cos(x - y), and power_reduction with double_angle.cos reproduces sin(x)^2. All rules are proved; v1 splits them into consistently oriented profiles, each checked for termination on the catalogue patterns.

complex: OSR v0.1 states tan(arctan z) = z without condition and cites Fungrim 1f026d for complex z; arctan is undefined at z = ±i and Complex.tan_arctan requires z ≠ I and z ≠ -I. The rule is sound for defined patterns only; engines must not apply it at z = ±i.
